case: 广告创意总监离开 4A，做独立创意工作室，专做中国品牌出海

case_display.zh: 广告创意总监离开 4A，做独立创意工作室，专做中国品牌出海
case_display.en: An advertising creative director leaves a 4A agency to start an independent creative studio specialising in taking Chinese brands overseas.

charge: 本案按现有陈述不能成立，不应按所描述的方式推进。

speech.zh: 法官阁下 · Your Honour，专业方向明确，但独立经营需要自己的客户来源。
speech.en: Your Honour, the specialism is clear, but an independent studio needs its own route to clients.

text.zh: 广告创意总监离开 4A，做独立创意工作室，专做中国品牌出海
text.en: An advertising creative director leaves a 4A agency to start an independent creative studio specialising in taking Chinese brands overseas.

text.zh: 离开原机构后，可能需要从零建立销售渠道。
text.en: Leaving the agency may mean building a sales channel from scratch.

text.zh: 只服务出海品牌可能让项目间隔更长。
text.en: Serving only brands going overseas could increase gaps between projects.

speech.zh: 法官阁下 · Your Honour，小工作室可以先用范围有限的项目验证需求。
speech.en: Your Honour, a small studio can test demand with a tightly scoped project.

concession.zh: 案由没有列出已经确认的客户。
concession.en: The record names no confirmed clients.

text.zh: 广告创意总监离开 4A，做独立创意工作室，专做中国品牌出海
text.en: An advertising creative director leaves a 4A agency to start an independent creative studio specialising in taking Chinese brands overseas.

text.zh: 出海专长可以给潜在客户明确的选择理由。
text.en: Overseas specialisation could give clients a clear reason to choose the studio.

text.zh: 独立工作室可能先从小项目开始。
text.en: An independent studio could start with small projects.

response.en: The case identifies the target customer.

response.zh: 明确定位本身不能证明需求。
response.en: A clear pitch does not establish demand.

response.zh: 没有说明首个项目从哪里来。
response.en: The opening gives no source for the first project.

issue.zh: 现有描述是否给出了取得首个项目的路径？
issue.en: Does the proposal identify a route to the first project?

response.zh: 双方都承认工作室会独立经营。
response.en: Both sides accept that the studio will be independent.

response.zh: 需要建立自己的获客渠道。
response.en: The studio will need its own route to clients.

response.zh: 记录没有证明专注会延长项目间隔。
response.en: The record does not establish that specialisation will lengthen gaps.

issue.en: Could the studio start with a limited pilot?

reason.zh: 依据控方开场第 2 点，没有首单价格，我无法判断独立业务是否撑得住。
reason.en: On Crown opening point 2, I cannot see how the studio supports itself without a price for its first job.

deciding_fact.zh: 广告创意总监离开 4A，做独立创意工作室，专做中国品牌出海
deciding_fact.en: An advertising creative director leaves a 4A agency to start an independent creative studio specialising in taking Chinese brands overseas.

would_flip_if.zh: 取得一份明确价格的试单。
would_flip_if.en: Secure a pilot with a stated price.

reason.zh: 依据控方开场第 2 点，我第一次听说这个服务，还不知道怎么买。
reason.en: On Crown opening point 2, hearing about the studio for the first time, I would not know how to buy its services.

deciding_fact.zh: 广告创意总监离开 4A，做独立创意工作室，专做中国品牌出海
deciding_fact.en: An advertising creative director leaves a 4A agency to start an independent creative studio specialising in taking Chinese brands overseas.

would_flip_if.zh: 让一位新客户确认购买步骤。
would_flip_if.en: Have a new client confirm the steps to purchase.

reason.zh: 依据控方开场第 2 点，我会先抢占这个细分市场的销售渠道。
reason.en: On Crown opening point 2, I would compete for the sales channels in this niche before the studio got established.

deciding_fact.zh: 广告创意总监离开 4A，做独立创意工作室，专做中国品牌出海
deciding_fact.en: An advertising creative director leaves a 4A agency to start an independent creative studio specialising in taking Chinese brands overseas.

would_flip_if.zh: 与一家渠道伙伴签下试点协议。
would_flip_if.en: Sign a pilot agreement with a referral partner.

reason.zh: 依据控方开场第 2 点，控方指出的缺口具体影响能否照原计划推进。
reason.en: On Crown opening point 2, the gap identified by the Crown directly affects whether the plan can proceed as stated.

deciding_fact.zh: 广告创意总监离开 4A，做独立创意工作室，专做中国品牌出海
deciding_fact.en: An advertising creative director leaves a 4A agency to start an independent creative studio specialising in taking Chinese brands overseas.

would_flip_if.zh: 提交一份已获客户确认的项目委托书。
would_flip_if.en: Produce a project brief accepted by a client.

reason.zh: 依据控方开场第 2 点，如果没有容易讲给别人听的首个项目，我不会转介绍。
reason.en: On Crown opening point 2, I would not tell friends about it without a first project I could explain easily.

deciding_fact.zh: 广告创意总监离开 4A，做独立创意工作室，专做中国品牌出海
deciding_fact.en: An advertising creative director leaves a 4A agency to start an independent creative studio specialising in taking Chinese brands overseas.

would_flip_if.zh: 让三位目标客户能复述试点内容。
would_flip_if.en: Ask three target clients to describe the pilot back to you.

reason.zh: 依据控方开场第 2 点，我看不出第一个项目怎样从需求走到交付。
reason.en: On Crown opening point 2, I cannot trace a path from a first client request to delivery.

deciding_fact.zh: 广告创意总监离开 4A，做独立创意工作室，专做中国品牌出海
deciding_fact.en: An advertising creative director leaves a 4A agency to start an independent creative studio specialising in taking Chinese brands overseas.

would_flip_if.zh: 列出首单的交付步骤并与客户演练。
would_flip_if.en: Walk through the first delivery plan with a client.

reason.zh: 依据控方开场第 2 点，我需要知道开业第一周谁负责找活。
reason.en: On Crown opening point 2, I need to know who is bringing in work in week one.

deciding_fact.zh: 广告创意总监离开 4A，做独立创意工作室，专做中国品牌出海
deciding_fact.en: An advertising creative director leaves a 4A agency to start an independent creative studio specialising in taking Chinese brands overseas.

would_flip_if.zh: 指定获客负责人并约好三次客户会谈。
would_flip_if.en: Name the lead for outreach and book three client meetings.

reason.zh: 依据控方开场第 2 点，一个细分定位不能说明有多少品牌愿意购买。
reason.en: On Crown opening point 2, a niche tells me little about how many brands will buy.

deciding_fact.zh: 广告创意总监离开 4A，做独立创意工作室，专做中国品牌出海
deciding_fact.en: An advertising creative director leaves a 4A agency to start an independent creative studio specialising in taking Chinese brands overseas.

would_flip_if.zh: 记录二十家目标品牌对同一报价的回应。
would_flip_if.en: Record responses from twenty prospects to the same offer.

reason.zh: 依据控方开场第 2 点，在没有项目承诺前，我不愿把家庭时间押在全职启动上。
reason.en: On Crown opening point 2, I would not commit family time to a full-time launch before a client commits.

deciding_fact.zh: 广告创意总监离开 4A，做独立创意工作室，专做中国品牌出海
deciding_fact.en: An advertising creative director leaves a 4A agency to start an independent creative studio specialising in taking Chinese brands overseas.

would_flip_if.zh: 安排一项明确工时的付费试点。
would_flip_if.en: Set up a paid pilot with agreed hours.

reason.zh: 依据控方开场第 2 点，我需要先看到可重复获客的一步。
reason.en: On Crown opening point 2, I want to see the first step in a repeatable way to attract clients.

deciding_fact.zh: 广告创意总监离开 4A，做独立创意工作室，专做中国品牌出海
deciding_fact.en: An advertising creative director leaves a 4A agency to start an independent creative studio specialising in taking Chinese brands overseas.

would_flip_if.zh: 通过同一渠道找到两位试点客户。
would_flip_if.en: Find two pilot clients through the same channel.

reason.zh: 依据辩方开场第 2 点，我认为明确的受众值得先测试。
reason.en: On Defence opening point 2, I think the defined audience merits a test.

deciding_fact.zh: 广告创意总监离开 4A，做独立创意工作室，专做中国品牌出海
deciding_fact.en: An advertising creative director leaves a 4A agency to start an independent creative studio specialising in taking Chinese brands overseas.

would_flip_if.zh: 如果五位目标客户都无法理解服务价值，我会改票。
would_flip_if.en: I would flip if five target clients could not explain the value of the offer.

reason.zh: 依据辩方开场第 3 点，记录不足以证明试点会因权责问题受阻。
reason.en: On Defence opening point 3, I see no evidence in the record that liability would block a pilot.

deciding_fact.zh: 广告创意总监离开 4A，做独立创意工作室，专做中国品牌出海
deciding_fact.en: An advertising creative director leaves a 4A agency to start an independent creative studio specialising in taking Chinese brands overseas.

would_flip_if.zh: 若客户要求条款中有无法接受的无限责任，我会改票。
would_flip_if.en: I would flip if a client insisted on uncapped liability in the pilot agreement.

sentence.zh: 陪审团达到多数门槛。现有描述缺少取得首单的路径；请先验证获客和交付，再决定是否独立开业。
sentence.en: The jury reached the required majority. The proposal lacks a route to a first commission. Test acquisition and delivery before committing to the independent launch.

text.zh: 控方指出独立获客没有具体路径。
text.en: The Crown identified the missing route to clients.

text.zh: 辩方提出的小试点可以验证需求。
text.en: The Defence identified a small pilot as a way to test demand.

conditions.zh: 取得一份明确价格的试单。
conditions.en: Secure a pilot with a stated price.

conditions.en: Walk through the first delivery plan with a client.

conditions.zh: 记录二十家目标品牌对同一报价的回应。

conditions.en: Secure a pilot with a stated price.

conditions.zh: 列出首单的交付步骤并与客户演练。
conditions.en: Walk through the first delivery plan with a client.

conditions.zh: 记录二十家目标品牌对同一报价的回应。
conditions.en: Record responses from twenty prospects to the same offer.

speech.zh: 陪审团各位成员 · Members of the jury，控方指出获客路径未交代，辩方提出可小规模试点。举证责任在控方。请区分原文事实与推断，只根据庭审记录裁决。
speech.en: Members of the jury, the Crown points to the missing route to clients. The Defence proposes a small pilot. The burden is on the Crown. Distinguish inference from fact and decide solely on the record.
